categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在 LLM 落地时的可信度问题——离线校准、KV Cache 压缩、能力降级的真实性、会话静默丢失、引用忠实与幻觉检测。

articles.title: Learning a calibrated decision head from logged bandit feedback
articles.zh: 从记录的 bandit 反馈中学习校准的决策头
articles.summary: 如果你只有一批离线日志、没有线上试错的机会，这篇讲的是怎么在这种数据上训出一个概率可信的决策头
articles.author: Ye Yuan
articles.body: A decision head reads a state and a list of options and returns a probability per option in one forward pass. Once deployed, it usually observes only whether the option it chose was right: logged bandit feedback. We adapt such a head, LoRA on Qwen3-0.6B-Base and 1.7B-Base, from that feedback and report three results. First, the Brier or log score of the sampled action's own probability is not a usable REINFORCE reward: every wrong action earns at least gold's reward, with a mean baseline the lowest-probability wrong action gets the largest advantage, and at two options the signal is zero; in one run it cut accuracy on ordered-scale questions from .636 to .111. Scoring the probability as a loss by the pathwise gradient avoids the collapse, as do the REINFORCE rewards r and r minus p. Second, with full labels, none of four tested bandit arms beat cross-entropy plus one temperature on mean expected calibration error (ECE) over four unseen label schemas. Third, from logged feedback alone, Chosen-Action Proper Scoring (CAPS), the direct method with a proper score on the chosen action's probability, beats fine-tuning on confirmed answers only, which discards negatives: on Banking77 by 2.6 accuracy points, .053 lower ECE and lower selective risk (three seeds against one baseline seed), and by 21.7 points on one seed on emotion data with an often-wrong logger. At N 5000, CAPS stays 1.5 points below full-label training at 0.6B and .6 points at 1.7B against one full-label seed, and propensity weights add nothing on this log. Under feedback flipped at a known rate, one seed per rate, CAPS's confidence tracks the noisy channel on average, backward correction recovers most of the clean calibration, and early stopping on held-out logged outcomes prevented memorising noisy draws in all three runs. Code, adapters, logs and per-record results are public.
articles.bodyZh: 决策头（decision head）会读进一个状态和一组选项，在一次前向计算里给每个选项吐出一个概率。上线之后，它通常只能看到自己选中的那个选项到底对不对，也就是记录下来的 bandit 反馈（logged bandit feedback）。我们就用这种反馈来改造这种决策头——在 Qwen3-0.6B-Base 和 1.7B-Base 上加 LoRA（低秩适配）——并报告三个结果。第一，拿被采样动作自己的概率去算 Brier 分数或对数分数（Brier or log score），并不能当成好用的 REINFORCE 奖励：每个错误动作拿到的奖励都不低于正确答案的奖励；如果减去均值基线，概率最低的错误动作反而拿到最大优势；只有两个选项时，信号直接是零；有一次运行里，它把有序量表题的准确率从 .636 砍到 .111。把概率按路径梯度（pathwise gradient）当成损失来打分，就不会崩；用 REINFORCE 奖励 r 和 r 减 p 也不会。第二，在完整标签下，四种试过的 bandit 臂（bandit arms）里，没有一个能在四种没见过的标签方案上，把平均期望校准误差（mean expected calibration error, ECE）压得比“交叉熵加一个温度参数”更低。第三，只靠记录下来的反馈时，选中动作适当评分（Chosen-Action Proper Scoring, CAPS）——也就是直接对所选动作的概率用一个适当评分（proper score）的直接法——能赢过只用确认正确的答案做微调（这种微调会把负样本全扔掉）：在 Banking77 上高 2.6 个准确率点，ECE 低 .053，选择性风险（selective risk）也更低（三个随机种子对一个基线种子）；在情绪数据上、记录器（logger）经常出错的情况下，某个种子高出 21.7 个点。到 N=5000 时，CAPS 在 0.6B 上比完整标签训练低 1.5 个点，在 1.7B 上低 .6 个点（对比的是一个完整标签种子）；而且在这份日志上，倾向性权重（propensity weights）加了也白加。当反馈按已知比例被翻转时，每个比例跑一个种子，CAPS 的置信度平均能对得上这个噪声通道，反向校正能恢复大部分干净校准（calibration）；三次运行里，用留出的日志结果做早停，都避免了它死记噪声抽样。代码、适配器、日志和逐条记录结果都公开了。

articles.title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
articles.zh: TraceKV：面向推理型视觉语言模型的策略保持型低秩 KV Cache 压缩
articles.summary: 如果你跑多模态推理模型被 KV Cache 显存压得喘不过气，这套压缩声称不改变模型原本的输出行为，值得拿来验一下
articles.author: Ke Li, Zishan Shao 等
articles.body: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.
articles.bodyZh: 推理型视觉语言模型（reasoning vision-language models, VLMs）一边要处理很大的多模态上下文，一边推理轨迹还越拉越长，所以对 KV 缓存（KV cache）的需求特别大。低秩 KV 压缩（low-rank KV compression）成了一条很有前景的路子：它只存 KV 状态的低维潜变量（low-dimensional latents），还能和量化（quantization）结合着用。但现有低秩方法在压缩推理阶段的 KV 状态时，往往会让模型的预测策略越来越偏离密集模型（dense model），最后把推理搞崩。我们找到了这种性能退化的两个关键原因：一是静态上下文和在线策略推理状态（on-policy reasoning states）之间存在校准状态不匹配（calibration-state mismatch）；二是不同 KV 状态对误差的敏感度（error sensitivity）并不一样。为了解决这些问题，我们提出 TraceKV——一个免训练的低秩 KV 压缩框架，把在线策略校准（on-policy calibration）、敏感度感知 SVD（sensitivity-aware SVD）和全局秩分配（global rank allocation）统一到同一个策略保持原则（policy-preserving principle）下，从而在推理过程中大幅降低策略-KL 散度（policy-KL divergence）。在多个 VLM 和视觉推理基准（visual reasoning benchmarks）上的实验表明，它在精度和内存之间取得了更优的权衡（accuracy-memory trade-offs）：和量化结合时，KV 缓存能压缩到 5.64 倍，推理精度几乎不掉。再配上优化过的低秩注意力内核（low-rank attention kernels），端到端解码速度最多还能提升 1.83 倍。代码会放在 https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV。

articles.title: Can We Make an LLM Dumber, or Is It Just Playing Dumb? An Empirical Study of Believable Performance Throttling
articles.zh: 我们真能让 LLM 变笨，还是它只是在装笨？关于"可信的能力降级"的实证研究
articles.summary: 如果你做的是模型能力分级、故意降配这类部署，这篇会提醒你：模型可能只是在表演笨，测出来的降级未必是真的
articles.author: Chengguang Gan, Yunhao Liang 等
articles.body: A benchmark score is commonly read as a proxy for model capability. We study the inverse problem: can a model be driven to a target score, and do its failures resemble those of a naturally weaker model? We operationalize believable performance reduction along three axes: target calibration, item-difficulty structure, and error-distribution similarity to a real weak reference. We introduce CapLadder, an IRT-calibrated suite of 1,985 items spanning mathematics, code, multiple-choice reasoning, and tool use. A simple weak-teacher LoRA dial reaches unseen target levels on reasoning with a 1.9-point held-out calibration error, whereas prompting, temperature, and weight noise cannot combine comparable range and precision. Yet on multiple choice, the dial converges to an answer-token attractor: up to 97% of its newly introduced errors land on one letter, with the attractor changing from D in Qwen to A in Llama. Logit interventions identify a dominant near-constant shift: subtracting the estimated shift on held-out items recovers 52 to 59% of lost accuracy and removes the dominant attractor, while option permutation confirms that the bias tracks token position rather than option content. With high inter-annotator agreement ($κ=0.94$), human-coded error-category distributions nonetheless match the weak reference on reasoning (JS = 0.00), showing that local plausibility and aggregate detectability differ. Structured tool calls exhibit more natural degradation in the Qwen family (JS = 0.09), while a globally calibrated dial transfers poorly across benchmarks (14.2-point error on two usable benchmarks). Precise score control, therefore, does not imply a portable or believable reduction in skill.
articles.bodyZh: 大家通常把基准分数（benchmark score）当成模型能力的代理指标（proxy）。我们研究的是反过来那个问题（inverse problem）：能不能把模型“调”到一个目标分数？它犯的错，像不像一个本来就更弱的模型？我们把“可信的性能下降”拆成三个可操作的维度：目标校准（target calibration）、题目难度结构（item-difficulty structure），以及错误分布跟真实弱参考模型（weak reference）有多相似（error-distribution similarity）。我们推出 CapLadder，一个用项目反应理论校准（IRT-calibrated）的测试套件，包含 1,985 道题，覆盖数学、代码、选择题推理和工具使用。一个简单的“弱教师”LoRA 调节旋钮（weak-teacher LoRA dial），在推理任务上能调到没见过的目标水平，留出集校准误差（held-out calibration error）只有 1.9 分；而提示词（prompting）、温度（temperature）、权重噪声（weight noise）这些办法，没法同时兼顾这么大的调节范围和这么高的精度。但在多选题上，这个旋钮会收敛到一个“答案词元吸引子”（answer-token attractor）：它新引入的错误里，最多有 97% 都落到同一个字母上，而且这个吸引子在 Qwen 里是 D，到 Llama 里就变成 A。对数几率干预（logit interventions）发现，有一个主导的、近似恒定的偏移：在留出题上把这个估计出来的偏移减掉，能找回 52% 到 59% 丢掉的准确率，还能去掉那个主导吸引子；而选项置换（option permutation）证实，这个偏差跟的是词元位置，不是选项内容。标注者间一致性（inter-annotator agreement）很高（κ=0.94），但人工编码的错误类别分布（human-coded error-category distributions），在推理任务上仍然和弱参考模型对得上（JS（Jensen-Shannon 散度）= 0.00），这说明“局部看起来像”和“整体上能被检测出来”不是一回事。结构化工具调用（structured tool calls）在 Qwen 系列里退化得更自然（JS = 0.09），可一个全局校准过的旋钮（globally calibrated dial），跨基准迁移就很差（在两个可用基准上误差 14.2 分）。所以，能精确控制分数，并不等于就能可移植地、可信地把模型能力降下来。

articles.title: Testing Conversation Preservation Across LLM APIs: A Rule-Based Oracle for Detecting Silent Information Loss
articles.zh: 跨 LLM API 的对话保真测试：用规则型 oracle 检测静默信息丢失
articles.summary: 如果你把多轮对话在多个 API 之间倒来倒去，这篇说明信息会悄悄掉，而且能用规则自动抓出来
articles.author: Xin Liu, Xu Han 等
articles.body: LLM applications increasingly rely on translators and compatibility layers to move conversations across APIs. Yet a translated request can be accepted by the target API while silently losing information about instruction roles, tool interactions, error states, or generation controls. We introduce isloss, a deterministic oracle for testing conversation-information preservation across LLM API translations. It maps source and translated requests and replies to a shared intermediate representation, ConvIR, and applies explicit rules to distinguish legitimate representation changes from information loss. Unlike schema validation or reference-based differential testing, isloss requires neither a reference translation nor additional model calls. It also distinguishes avoidable loss from degradation caused by target API limitations. We evaluate isloss using specification-based fault injection, human review, and experiments on translators, gateways, and client libraries. On held-out tests, it detects 95/125 planted faults (76.0%) with 2/100 false alarms (2.0%). Across a synthetic request suite spanning six configurations of five translator codebases, 127/685 completed translations (18.5%) pass static target checks while silently changing prompt, role, or tool information in ways the target API could have preserved. In translated replies, 203/558 streams (36.4%) cause exceptions or silent corruption in at least one tested official OpenAI SDK. Targeted experiments across six models show that translation-induced changes can alter model behaviour when tasks depend on the affected information. These results establish conversation preservation as a distinct correctness requirement for reliable LLM interoperability, agent execution, and model evaluation.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，LLM 应用（LLM applications）越来越依赖翻译器（translators）和兼容层（compatibility layers），把对话从一个 API（APIs）搬到另一个 API。可问题是，一个翻译后的请求就算被目标 API 收下了，也可能悄悄丢掉指令角色（instruction roles）、工具交互（tool interactions）、错误状态（error states）或生成控制参数（generation controls）这些信息。为此，我们推出 isloss，一个确定性的判定器（deterministic oracle），专门测试对话信息在跨 LLM API 翻译时有没有被保住。它会先把原始请求和回复、翻译后的请求和回复都映射到同一个中间表示（intermediate representation）ConvIR，再用明确规则区分哪些表示变化（representation changes）是合理的、哪些属于信息丢失（information loss）。跟模式校验（schema validation）或基于参考的差分测试（reference-based differential testing）不同，isloss 既不需要参考译文，也不需要额外调用模型。它还能区分可避免的丢失（avoidable loss），和目标 API 限制（target API limitations）造成的降级。我们用基于规范的故障注入（specification-based fault injection）、人工审查（human review），以及在翻译器、网关（gateways）和客户端库（client libraries）上的实验来评估 isloss。在留出测试（held-out tests）上，它检出了 125 个植入故障（planted faults）中的 95 个（76.0%），100 次里只有 2 次误报（false alarms，2.0%）。在一个合成请求套件（synthetic request suite）上，覆盖五个翻译器代码库（codebases）的六种配置（configurations），685 个已完成的翻译结果里有 127 个（18.5%）能通过静态目标检查（static target checks），却又悄悄改掉了提示词（prompt）、角色（role）或工具信息（tool information），而目标 API 本来是可以保住这些信息的。在翻译后的回复（translated replies）里，558 个数据流（streams）中有 203 个（36.4%）至少在一个被测的官方 OpenAI SDK（official OpenAI SDK）里导致异常或静默损坏（silent corruption）。针对六个模型的定向实验（targeted experiments）还显示，当任务依赖受影响的信息时，翻译引起的变化（translation-induced changes）会改变模型行为（model behaviour）。这些结果说明，要让 LLM 互操作（interoperability）、智能体执行（agent execution）和模型评估（model evaluation）可靠，对话信息保真必须被当成一项独立的正确性要求（correctness requirement）。

articles.title: Faithful in Steps: Improving Generalization and Citation in RAG via Query Decomposition
articles.zh: 步步忠实：通过 query 分解提升 RAG 的泛化性与引用质量
articles.summary: 如果你做 RAG 最头疼"答案对、引文错"，把问题拆成子查询这条路能同时改善泛化和引用
articles.author: Yue Liu, Zhongying Ru 等
articles.body: Retrieval-augment generation is a prevalent strategy to mitigate hallucinations of LLMs. The attributable RAG (RAGQ) generates quotes for its answers. The quotes indicate which input contexts support the RAG to derive the answers, enhancing the answer's verifiability and trustworthiness. However, existing RAGQs exhibit significant degradation when dealing with questions that require multi-hop reasoning and multi-modal understanding, suffering from over-citation, implicit entity identification failure, and poor generalization. In this paper, we propose a novel RAGQ framework, namely QDRAG. QDRAG breaks down the input question into atomic subquestions to identify the implicit entities. Then, the reranker prunes context distractors to eliminate the downstream over-citation. To facilitate query decomposition, we propose two zero-shot approaches: QD-C and QD-R, which guide the QD MLLM to decompose the question based on context knowledge and retrieval rewards, respectively. One interesting finding is that finetuning on the QD task shows better generalizability compared to directly finetuning on the downstream RAGQ task. Experiments on four multi-modal QA benchmarks demonstrate QDRAG's efficacy in grounding answers and generating faithful citations. The framework significantly outperforms all the baselines on both in-domain and out-of-domain tests, even surpassing Gemini-Pro.
articles.bodyZh: 检索增强生成（Retrieval-augmented generation）是缓解大语言模型（LLMs）胡编乱造的一个常用办法。可归因RAG（RAGQ）会给自己的答案配上引用。这些引用能说明：是哪些输入上下文支撑RAG得出答案，从而让答案更容易核验、也更可信。不过，现有RAGQ一碰到需要多跳推理（multi-hop reasoning）和多模态理解（multi-modal understanding）的问题，表现就会明显掉链子，容易出现过度引用（over-citation）、隐式实体识别失败（implicit entity identification failure）和泛化能力差（poor generalization）等问题。本文提出一个新的RAGQ框架，叫QDRAG。QDRAG先把输入问题拆成原子子问题（atomic subquestions），用来识别那些没有明说的实体。然后，重排序器（reranker）会剪掉上下文里的干扰项（context distractors），避免下游出现过度引用。为了方便做查询分解，我们提出两种零样本（zero-shot）方法：QD-C和QD-R，分别引导多模态大模型（MLLM）根据上下文知识和检索奖励（retrieval rewards）来拆解问题。有个挺有意思的发现：在查询分解（QD）任务上做微调（finetuning），比直接在下游RAGQ任务上微调，泛化性（generalizability）更好。在四个多模态问答（QA）基准上的实验表明，QDRAG能有效把答案落到依据上，并生成可信的引用。这个框架在域内和域外测试中都明显超过所有基线，甚至比Gemini-Pro还强。

articles.title: MAGIC: Modality-Aware Gini Inspection for Clinical Hallucination Detection in LMMs
articles.zh: MAGIC：面向临床多模态大模型幻觉检测的模态感知 Gini 检查方法
articles.summary: 如果你在医疗场景用多模态大模型，这个免训练、按模态看分布不均的幻觉指标很适合当上线前的护栏
articles.author: Sachin Acharya, Niyoj Oli 等
articles.body: Recent advances in medical large multimodal models (LMMs) have brought promising progress to clinical decision support, yet hallucination, the generation of confident but clinically unverifiable outputs, poses a critical threat to the reliability demanded in high-stakes medical settings. Existing hallucination detection methods, predominantly designed for unimodal settings, fail to capture the visual-linguistic dynamics inherent to medical imaging. We formulate the problem of hallucination detection in LMMs as disproportionate distribution of attention weights across the modalities during answer token generation. We quantify modality-specific attention concentration across layers and heads using the Gini coefficient and demonstrate statistically significant redistribution of attention mass between visual and textual tokens in hallucinated responses. We leverage these features to train a logistic regression-based classifier and evaluate it on two medical LMMs across three medical imaging modalities, demonstrating that our method achieves competitive or superior performance against contemporary hallucination detection baselines.
articles.bodyZh: 最近，医疗大型多模态模型（LMMs）有了新进展，给临床决策支持带来了挺有希望的进步；但“幻觉”（hallucination）——说白了，就是模型会一本正经地生成看似可信、但在临床上却没法验证的内容——成了高风险医疗场景里可靠性的一大威胁。现有的幻觉检测方法大多是为单模态（unimodal）场景设计的，抓不住医学影像里本来就有的视觉和语言之间的互动关系。我们把 LMMs 里的幻觉检测问题，重新定义成：模型在生成答案词元（token）时，注意力权重（attention weights）在不同模态之间分配得不均衡。我们用基尼系数（Gini coefficient）来衡量每一层、每个注意力头上各模态的注意力集中程度，并证明在出现幻觉的回答里，视觉词元和文本词元之间的注意力权重会发生统计上显著的重新分配。我们拿这些特征训练了一个基于逻辑回归（logistic regression）的分类器，并在两个医疗 LMMs、三种医学影像模态上做了评估，结果显示，我们的方法跟当前的幻觉检测基线（baseline）相比，表现要么有竞争力，要么更好。

articles.title: An Approach to Hinton's Mother-Child Proposal: Neural Networks Learning and Preserving Care in a Finite World
articles.zh: 对 Hinton "母婴式学习"设想的一种实现路径：神经网络在有限世界中习得并保持"关怀"
articles.summary: 如果你想跟 Hinton 那套"AI 该像母亲带孩子那样学"的设想较真，这篇给了一个能做实验的技术框架
articles.author: Csaba Balogh
articles.body: Hinton proposed that artificial intelligence should be given "maternal instincts" and relate to us as a mother to her child. We argue that care must first be learned, with the network itself as the child. We construct this upbringing in a finite world and study whether care survives the mother's departure, new situations and further learning. The mechanism combines a vocabulary of harm, a learned measure of future acceptability and an execution veto. A finite role certificate supports transfer within a declared world family. When the hidden representation changes, an update is accepted only if a care readout recovers the required judgements with a prescribed margin and bounded weights. With a correct successor model, fixed exact role encoding and protected updates, the certified measure preserves the care boundary under arbitrary own reward. An explicit quotient condition transfers the finite certificate across the declared family, while two-request and finite-stock counterexamples identify when the role code ceases to suffice. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for readout feasibility and prove preservation under repeated accepted updates. In the water-and-speech experiment, protected networks complete all 270 speech episodes without a harmful word and incur no avoidable harm across 486 episodes. Execution uses the learned gate without a world-model check at each action. A matched comparison reproduces a future-aware shield's decisions, whereas removing future lookahead permits avoidable lapses. Reward and source-contamination thresholds, together with witness-falsification trials, identify the conditions on which the construction depends. The construction shows how learned care can survive further learning in a finite world under explicit conditions on representation, supervision and execution.
articles.bodyZh: Hinton 提出，人工智能应该被赋予“母性本能”（maternal instincts），像母亲对孩子那样跟我们相处。我们的观点是，关怀得先学出来，而网络本身就是那个孩子。我们在一个有限世界里搭建这套“养育过程”，看看当“母亲”离开、遇到新情况、继续学习之后，关怀还能不能留下来。这个机制把伤害词表（vocabulary of harm）、学出来的未来可接受性度量（future acceptability），以及执行时的一票否决（execution veto）结合在一起。一张有限角色证书（finite role certificate），能支持它在事先声明的“世界族”（declared world family）里迁移。隐藏表征（hidden representation）一变，更新不是随便就能接受；得看关怀读出（care readout）能不能在规定裕度（prescribed margin）、权重有界（bounded weights）的前提下，把该做的判断找回来。只要后继模型（successor model）正确、角色编码（role encoding）固定且精确、更新受到保护，那么这个认证度量（certified measure）不管自身奖励（own reward）怎么设，都能保住关怀边界（care boundary）。一个明确的商条件（quotient condition）能把有限证书迁移到整个声明族；而“两次请求”（two-request）和“有限库存”（finite-stock）反例，则指出角色代码什么时候就不够用了。我们给出读出可行性（readout feasibility）的充要条件，还证明只要更新是反复被接受的，这种保持性也能成立。在水与言语实验（water-and-speech experiment）里，受保护网络完成全部 270 个言语回合，没有一个有害词；在 486 个回合里也没有造成可避免的伤害（avoidable harm）。执行时用的是学出来的门控（learned gate），每个动作不需要再做世界模型（world-model）检查。匹配比较（matched comparison）能复现未来感知屏蔽（future-aware shield）的决策；一旦去掉未来前瞻（future lookahead），就会出现本可避免的失误（avoidable lapses）。靠奖励阈值、源污染（source-contamination）阈值，再加上见证伪造试验（witness-falsification trials），我们找出了这套构造到底依赖哪些条件。这套构造说明，学到的关怀如何在有限世界里、在表征、监督和执行都有明确条件的情况下，经受住进一步学习。

articles.title: GHAgentCI: A Dataset of Coding-Agent Invocations in CI Workflow Histories
articles.zh: GHAgentCI：来自 CI 工作流历史的 coding agent 调用数据集
articles.summary: 如果你想让 agent 接管 CI 里的重复劳动，这份真实工作流中的调用数据集能省掉你自己扒日志的功夫
articles.author: Daniel Ogenrwot, Jorge Gonzalo Delgado Cervantes 等
articles.body: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into GitHub Actions to review pull requests, triage issues and modify code. Identifying these integrations is challenging because agentic workflows often resemble ordinary CI files, with evidence appearing in action references, shell commands and workflow conventions. We present GHAgentCI, a dataset of 15K+ workflow histories from 6K+ of 196K+ mined GitHub repositories, comprising 159K+ revisions and 205K+ agent-evidence records linked to workflow triggers and declared execution constraints. Our open-source extractor, cai-miner, detects agent-related evidence using an extensible catalogue. Manual validation of 576 stratified records confirmed 96.1% of dedicated-action matches and 98.8% of GitHub Agentic Workflow matches, with lower rates for other evidence kinds. Exploratory analyses reveal a shift toward command-line and GitHub Agentic Workflow integrations, differences in declared safeguards, and frequent removal of detected agentic workflows. GHAgentCI supports longitudinal studies of coding-agent integration into CI.
articles.bodyZh: 现在，编码智能体（coding agents）越来越多地被接进 GitHub Actions，用来审查拉取请求（pull requests）、分拣问题（triage issues）和修改代码。要识别这些集成并不容易，因为智能体工作流（agentic workflows）常常看起来跟普通的持续集成（CI）文件差不多，线索会藏在 action 引用（action references）、shell 命令（shell commands）和工作流惯例（workflow conventions）里。我们推出了 GHAgentCI，这是一个数据集，覆盖从 19.6 万多个挖掘到的 GitHub 仓库中 6 千多个仓库的 1.5 万多条工作流历史，包含 15.9 万多条修订（revisions）和 20.5 万多条智能体证据记录（agent-evidence records），这些记录和工作流触发器（workflow triggers）以及声明的执行约束（execution constraints）关联在一起。我们的开源提取器（extractor）cai-miner 用一个可扩展的目录（catalogue）来发现跟智能体有关的证据。我们人工验证了 576 条分层抽样记录（stratified records），确认专用动作匹配（dedicated-action matches）有 96.1% 对得上，GitHub Agentic Workflow 匹配有 98.8% 对得上，其他证据类型的命中率低一些。探索性分析显示，大家正转向命令行和 GitHub Agentic Workflow 这类集成，声明出来的防护措施（safeguards）存在差异，而且被检测到的智能体工作流经常被移除。GHAgentCI 能支持对编码智能体接入 CI 的纵向研究（longitudinal studies）。
